## Objective

Continue the staged LEAN runtime qualification after merged Issue #17 / PR #18. Execute the next coherent falsification slice from the merged Issue #11 fixture matrix: **Q04–Q11 only**.

Base/source of truth: `feat/alpaca-paper-foundation` at current head after PR #18. Read:
- `trading_agent_starter/LEAN_CONTRACT_QUALIFICATION_20261018.md`
- `trading_agent_starter/research/lean_qualification_011/FIXTURE_MATRIX.md`
- `trading_agent_starter/research/lean_terminal_017/LEAN_TERMINAL_GATE_20261018.md`
- `.agents/skills/trading-project/SKILL.md`

## Scope

Run Q04–Q11 exactly as designed:
- Q04 listing identity / ticker reuse
- Q05 structural vs knowledge clocks
- Q06 decision quote validity boundaries
- Q07 delayed first valid quote
- Q08 nanosecond precision / availability / ordering
- Q09 no-lookahead / revisions
- Q10 size / conditions / gaps
- Q11 raw vs adjusted

Reuse the qualified LEAN pin and public seams from Issue #17 where appropriate. Do not change the scientific contract to fit engine behavior.

## Immediate stop / failure conditions

Stop and return `LEAN_BLOCKER_FOUND` if any required behavior needs:
- current-symbol lookup that can remap historical identity or carried holdings;
- converting date-only structural evidence into an exact intraday state;
- using event time as availability/receipt when the fixture says otherwise;
- reordering causal events because LEAN/.NET clock precision collapses distinct source times;
- future revisions/corrections changing prior outputs;
- adjusted-price execution, double corporate-action treatment, or silent raw/adjusted substitution;
- implicit share-unit assumptions, trade/bar fallback for quote capacity, or silent data-gap repair;
- reflection/private-member access, durable LEAN core patch, paid entitlement, broker/provider auth, secrets, or scientific registration changes.

If a bounded technical limitation prevents a decision without establishing a blocker, return `LEAN_IDENTITY_TIME_GATE_INCOMPLETE`. If every Q04–Q11 variant passes exactly, return `LEAN_IDENTITY_TIME_GATE_PASS`.

## Evidence and validation

- Freeze exact input/expected-output fixtures before execution.
- Preserve nanosecond/source ordering externally where native precision is insufficient; prove the adapter does not invent or reorder causality.
- Compare canonical business outputs exactly; no equity-curve/performance tolerance.
- Run each accepted variant from clean processes and prove deterministic replay.
- Record source/build/config/input/output hashes and exact versions.
- Keep changes issue-scoped to a new qualification packet/minimal harness only.
- Run repository 240-test suite, comparator checks as applicable, demo, and hosted Ubuntu/Windows CI on final PR head.
- Fresh independent review before merge.

## Boundaries

No Q12–Q33, no FMBH/Databento or Amendment 005 changes, no candidate advancement, no alpha/performance experiment, no broker plugin qualification, no Paper/Live, no credentials, no paid calls/purchases, no scientific registration change.

## Workflow

Use dedicated branch `research/issue-19-lean-identity-time-spike`. Prefer Codex Goal mode. Persist checkpoints before usage interruption and resume from them. Stop at the Q04–Q11 decision and open a draft PR to `feat/alpaca-paper-foundation`; do not continue merely because the gate passes.
title: Run LEAN identity/time qualification spike (Q04–Q11 only)
